CT & MRI and X-Ray Technician update
Tuesday, 09 July 2024
1986 Hits
Applications received for the post of Asstt. Radio Technician, CT & MRI and X-Ray Technician have been scrutinized on the basis of criterion mentioned in the advertisement. Following applicants have been found to eligible & not eligible in accordance with the eligibility criteria as mentioned in the advertisement.
In case if any of the applicant is not satisfied with the reasons for ineligibility he/she may submit his/her representation, supported by documents as evidence. Please contact MS Office (Personal Section) before 18th July 2024, up to 5.00 PM. No requests shall be entertained beyond the specified period. Representations without supporting documents will not be entertained.  Eligible candidates will have to report at Medical Superintendent office with original documents for verification & there personal interview on 23
th
July 2024 at 10.00 AM. The list of qualified candidates will be displayed in our website and notice board.
Asstt Radio Tech. , CT & MRI and X-Ray Eligible & Not eligible list
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
